project_name: Pretty Wise Tips — Cinematic Affirmations Pilot 01
instructions_to_codex: Read this JSON as a complete production specification. Work inside the EXISTING Remotion repository; preserve working components and replace development-placeholder composition with a true art-based composition.

The user has ALREADY supplied a MAIN CHARACTER REFERENCE IMAGE and an ELEVENLABS VOICE AUDIO FILE to this Codex task. Inspect the current project and attachments; identify their actual paths. Do not invent filenames or ask the user to reupload accessible files.

A motion or reference-animation video may also be attached. If present, study timing, shot rhythm and limited-animation techniques; do not copy identifiable storyboards, characters or exact frames from it.

Create a finished original 4:5 portrait video with fully illustrated 1990s Western cel-TV style scenes, not text cards, crude SVG people or development placeholders. The character and locations must be rendered as real cohesive artwork.

If a required illustration is not available and no authorized art-generation capability is connected, STOP before the purported final render, provide the missing artwork prompts and an asset manifest, and make the code ready to ingest those images. Never claim a cinematic character animation exists when only a flattened still and camera movements are available.

output_specification.reference_assets_generated_in: 4:5 (1080x1350 minimum, preferably 2160x2700 for detailed master artwork)
output_specification.crop_policy: Never stretch, squeeze, or blindly crop character faces. Art direct all scenes natively for a 4:5 frame. Use a separately configured 9:16 derivative only if the user later requests it.
output_specification.duration: Use the verified duration and word timings of the supplied ElevenLabs audio. Target approximately 24 seconds if compatible; do not speed up, truncate or replace the supplied voice to force an arbitrary duration.
output_specification.full_screen_reel_note: 4:5 is the user-requested master. Instagram Reel full-screen normally favors 9:16 and may show margins or different cropping; keep all essential content inside the native 4:5 frame.

use_for: environment detail only, not character replacement

preflight: List actual source files and record real resolved paths and dimensions.
Read voiceover duration with ffprobe (or equivalent); extract waveform and timestamps.
Transcribe/align supplied voice if transcription capability exists. Otherwise keep editable phrase timing and use provided script as a provisional guide, explicitly labeled.
Inspect main character reference visually, not only by filename.
Reject any render using text-only placeholder images, missing illustrations or unapproved substitute characters.

character_bible.identity: One original recurring glamorous adult brunette character, based on the user-provided red-dress 1990s cel illustration; preserve her identity and facial geometry consistently.
character_bible.face: Elegant mature almond-shaped eyes, defined arched brows, simplified angular nose, softly shaped red lips, tiny beauty mark if it is visible in supplied original, expressive eyelids and refined cheek structure.
character_bible.hair: Large sculpted dark chestnut / burgundy-brown vintage wave and curled forelock, long thick polished waves with broad flat highlight shapes; same hair volume and silhouette in all shots.
character_bible.skin: Warm deep honey-caramel brown with flat base tone and one cel shadow tone; no photoreal skin texture.
character_bible.outfit_lock: Elegant fitted deep crimson red midi dress with long sleeves and draped waist, pearl stud earrings and short pearl necklace, understated pearl bracelet, matching red pumps. Do not spontaneously change outfit between scenes.
character_bible.personality: Adult, serene, financially self-assured, poised, warm, thoughtful, elegant; never childish, vulgar, hypersexualized or cartoonishly arrogant.
consistency_requirements: Same eyes, nose, lips and face structure in all scenes
Same red dress except harmless exposure to lighting
No extra fingers, disappearing hands, face changes or hairstyle substitutions
character_bible.reference_priority: Uploaded character image overrides textual approximations if there is a conflict.

style_bible.drawing: Traditional hand-drawn 2D appearance; clean confident black/dark umber outlines, broad flat fills, appealing angular silhouettes and simple elegant face geometry.
style_bible.shading: Only one or two hard-edged cel-shadow shapes per major surface; avoid airbrushing, realistic shine, specular gradients and 3D volume rendering.
style_bible.backgrounds: Period-style hand-painted architectural backgrounds, simplified but rich and believable: detailed perspective, restrained surface marks, harmonious color shapes; not stock photos.
style_bible.colors: Warm burgundy, olive, muted ochre, brass, dusty sky blue, cream and warm stone in environments. Clothing remains crimson. Brand mark may use very subtle lavender but do not repaint the vintage scenes into modern lavender infographics.
style_bible.broadcast_finish: Gentle low-amplitude analog grain, very mild softened edge and optional faint color bleed, subdued vintage broadcast tonality; no artificial VHS scratch overload or glitch.
negative_prompt: unrelated graphic icons as primary imagery
style_bible.animation_language: Limited 2D cel animation: primarily held drawings with deliberate acting poses, blinks, small head/arm movements, tasteful background movement and cinematic cuts; export smoothly at 30fps though character pose swaps may intentionally be on twos.

reference_transcript_only_if_matches_aud: I don't wait for someone to tell me I'm worthy.
I know what I bring into every room.
I can admire beautiful things without forgetting my own value.
I prepare for opportunities instead of begging for attention.
I am allowed to want more.
And every day, I become the woman I once imagined.
alignment_rules: DO NOT replace provided audio with synthetic voice.
Extract real voice duration and phrase onsets; set scene in/out points from those anchors rather than blindly assuming the audio is 24 seconds.
If narration differs from the provisional transcript, use exact supplied audio, not the provisional text.
If speech alignment is not available, provide a timing adjustment file and mark provisional captions; verify manually against playback before final export.
audio_and_text.music: No music unless the user supplied licensed music; keep any optional music clearly below narration.

captions.placement: horizontal center, around 68–78% of frame height where faces and hands are not covered; adjust per shot
captions.text_color: off-white in dark scenes / deep charcoal in bright scenes
captions.font: classic clean editorial sans serif, semibold
captions.highlight: minimal subtle warm gold or lavender on a single emphasized word
captions.appearance: gentle 4–6-frame fade or restrained upward pop, no flashy kinetic typography
captions.sync: time exact words to supplied voice when possible
captions.avoid: never cover facial expressions, hands, documents or key luxury details

scene_timing_strategy.description: Use quoted phrase anchors below; read the actual provided voice track, calculate in/out, insert cutaways within long clauses. Maintain the order and emotional arc. A 0.2–0.35 sec short tail hold is permitted after narration.

animation_specification.primary_strategy: Use high-quality separately illustrated assets for each shot. Code operates on actual pixels/layers and not fake vector caricatures.

flat_image_mode: Slow camera push/pan no more than about 3–7% change per shot
Cut between actual distinct illustrations for emotion or pose changes
Never invent lip-sync, walk cycles, independent blinks or hand motions from one flattened still
layered_assets_mode: Head pivot: small believable +/-2 degree rotations around neck
Blink: open, half-closed, closed sprites, 3–5 frames with natural rhythm
Hand gestures: separated elbow/forearm/hand cutout with correct pivots, no stretched wrists
Hair: restrained alternate drawn shapes, not liquid distortion
Parallax: foreground 3%, midground 1.5%, background 0.5% movement relative to camera, only if true layered image assets
motion_rules.scene_changes: Aim 1–2 subshots per line; mainly clean hard cuts with occasional 6–10 frame dissolve; avoid constant swooshes and modern transitions.
motion_rules.film_texture: Subtle consistent fine analog grain/TV softness as a final finishing pass; preview without grain to check artwork integrity.

animation_specification.artwork_manifest_rule: One artwork file per shot at minimum; layered independent assets preferred for blinking, arm actions, walking and props. Provide explicit file manifest generated from scene IDs and real input paths.
animation_specification.final_presentation: No scene descriptions, numbers, missing-art labels, logos blocking the portrait, raw filenames, debug guides, or obvious rectangles where artwork should be.

implementation_requirements.framework: Remotion + React + TypeScript in existing repository
implementation_requirements.config: Keep scenes, phrase anchors, shots and asset paths editable in JSON or TypeScript config; data-driven episode generator.
implementation_requirements.runtime_asset_validation: Before final render, verify every required shot illustration exists and has suitable 4:5 crop resolution. Missing image or voiceover = clear hard failure, no fallback placeholder in FINAL composition.
implementation_requirements.render_commands: Implement a reliable local preview and MP4 render script, inspect logs and verify final dimensions and duration with ffprobe.
sequence: Report actual asset and audio paths
Generate image asset prompt manifest for missing shots
Create/obtain complete artwork (only if actual image-generation tools exist)
Render entire master with supplied voice
Inspect sampled frames and confirm no placeholders
deliverables: A real 4:5 cinematic MP4 only if required artwork/audio assets actually exist
A short honest report listing which movements are truly animated and which are camera moves

blocking_quality_gates: Do not export a video containing any placeholder panels or text claiming an illustration is required.
Do not turn the single supplied character still into seven identical backgrounds via zoom effects; produce distinct artwork for distinct locations.
Do not claim the supplied character image makes actual body or facial animation possible without layers/alternate drawings.
Show cohesive 1990s Western cel illustration style on all original scenes; filters alone are insufficient.
Keep all output and asset master compositions native 4:5 1080x1350.
Do not generate a replacement voice. Use the uploaded ElevenLabs recording verbatim.
Match captions and cuts to the real recording, avoid off-sync text.
Reject frame warping, extra fingers, inconsistent hair and face, unwanted clothing changes.
Use recognizable coherent town buildings, kitchen architecture, boutique displays, office furnishings, and terrace setting as detailed above.
Verify no copied copyrighted character designs; make the heroine original while using general 1990s cel animation traits.
